text:
Maggie G.: Quick idea — run a 20-min mini webinar next Wed to surface the new pricing calculator and test dynamic FAQ copy. low-friction, product-led.
Dario P.: love that. goal is conversion to demo or self-serve commit?
Maggie G.: primary = demo leads from enterprise accounts, secondary = increase freemium trial starts via calc embed.
Simeon K.: can we gate the advanced estimator behind an email capture? maybe A/B test gated vs inline.
Elaine R.: +1 on A/B. if gated, route enterprise-looking emails to SDR queue. ops-bot: routing rule idea — if company_email_domain in enterprise_allowlist => tag:enterprise_lead
Dario P.: what counts as enterprise_allowlist? top 500 tech + finance domains? we should avoid false positives.
Maggie G.: we'll use: revenue signal + domain match + token-usage estimate. if two of three => SDR. else nurture flow.
Simeon K.: interface idea — swap FAQ panels depending on selected tier. eg: "Committed" shows SLA + Dedicated details; "Metered" shows burst/usage tips.
Elaine R.: write short microcopy for each panel. keep <3 bullets. example for Committed: "Predictable monthly price", "Dedicated capacity option", "SLA & priority support".
Dario P.: good. for Metered: "Pay-as-you-go tokens", "Autoscale burst for spikes", "Smart batching recommendations".
Maggie G.: webinar outline: 1) 5m pricing philosophy & benchmarks, 2) 7m live calculator demo (2 scenarios), 3) 5m Q&A and CTA to try calc + book demo.
Simeon K.: we should show cost/latency tradeoff benchmark slide — embed chart: redwood vs generic managed. Elaine, can you draft the benchmark narrative (1 paragraph) to use on the slide?
Elaine R.: will do. rough: "Benchmarks show config X reduces per-token cost by ~35% while keeping median latency within SLO for 90% of requests; ideal for high-throughput customers." will refine with numbers.
Maggie G.: perfect. ops-bot: add webinar event to /events and create routing rule to tag leads from registration form as webinar_inbound.
ops-bot: added event "pricing-mini-webinar-172999" and rule "tag:webinar_inbound" applied to registration_leads.
Dario P.: logistics: landing page + short promo post + 2 email sends (invitation + reminder). timeline: promo Mon, reminder Tue, webinar Wed.
Simeon K.: tracking: UTM campaign = pricing-mini-webinar-172999; page has two CTA buttons — "Try calc" (no gate) and "Advanced estimator" (gated). A/B assign 50/50.
Elaine R.: I'll draft FAQ variants and the registration copy. can someone help with copy QA Monday morning?
Maggie G.: I'll be on it with Elaine. Dario, can you confirm SDR routing and demo-book link?
Dario P.: will confirm by EOD. quick question — sample embed code for the calc on page? put a light snippet so devs can drop in.
Simeon K.: sample snippet:
<script src="https://cdn.redwood.ai/widgets/pricing-calc.js" data-mode="inline" data-utm="pricing-mini-webinar-172999"></script>
Maggie G.: love it. last thing: what success metrics? conversion to demo >= 8% from webinar leads, calc trials up 12% vs baseline, gated flow leads quality +20% (win-rate proxy).
Elaine R.: noted. I'll draft the playbook and post in #marketing-summaries by Monday.
